page.layout: One page of diagram: a title at the top, a large branching outline (synopsis) across the middle with braces and rotated side labels on the left, a line of text beneath it, and a catchword at the lower right. No page number, no running head.

page.notes: The page is a tree diagram; the outline levels follow the braces as far as they can be read, and the nesting of the lower boxes is approximate. The rotated labels on the left (Ars liberalis alia est, A, B, C, D) are read from the scan. "consideratur" is uncertain (the letters are faint). The first line of the left label "Externa, in qua consideratur" may read differently. The numbers 1, 2 and the lex entries are small and approximate. The "Discursus" and "observatio" lines are read as printed. Two small words on the left of the diagram near the title are not legible and are left out. The text "C Differen-" at the lower right is the catchword.
